name: Clean Lunch Ideas
equipment: A lunch container and basic cooking staples
instructions: Build lunch around a simple formula: a palm-sized protein, a fist of vegetables, and a cupped-hand of whole grains.
Choose grilled, baked, or steamed prep over fried when you have the choice -- it is an easy, low-effort swap.
Add healthy fats (avocado, olive oil, nuts) in moderation; they help you feel satisfied longer.
Watch today's video for quick, healthy lunch ideas built around this same formula.
